hatchloop/readiness.summary: Community-mapped OpenStreetMap data, unverified. A place the public servers are slow for answers partial/search_in_progress at 5 s; repeat the same call and it is usually served from cache.

description: Find real businesses near a place, sorted by distance (nearest of those examined; see result.search). Data: OpenStreetMap (ODbL, (c) OSM contributors); phone, website, hours only when mapped. Coverage varies; community-mapped, NOT verified by us; source=openstreetmap rows cannot be booked. Answers within about 5 s: status partial (search_in_progress) means repeat the call. If OSM is down: retriable 'temporarily unavailable', never invented rows. [free, no key] [beta]

availability_window.description: Accepted but NOT APPLIED: it does not narrow results (no live calendars). The…

capability.description: Kind of business: 'dentist', 'cafe', 'plumber'. Use it or vertical.

city.description: Instead of location: a city, e.g. 'Muscat, Oman'.

location.description: City/town or ZIP, optionally with country ('Nizwa, Oman'). Geocoded by OSM.

radius_miles.description: Radius in miles (default 3.1, max 25); applies to OpenStreetMap results only.

zip_or_city.description: Town, city, address or postal code, with the country if not US: 'Nizwa, Oman'. A bare 5-digit ZIP is a US ZIP; add the country for any other postal code.

price_band.description: Supply-network rows only (OpenStreetMap has no prices).

region.description: With city: a state or region.

name: find_business
